card.name: Botanical leaf descriptions
card.fires_on: Linking words or punctuation right after the word leaves (or leaf) in plant descriptions, where the next words give leaf shape, hairiness or color.

modes.label: Verb after leaves
modes.description: The word are or and right after a plant's leaves are named, before the leaf traits.
modes.example: Leaves<< are>> hairy and have 3–5 lob

modes.label: Comma or colon in leaf lists
modes.description: Punctuation in terse botanical keys listing leaf traits one after another.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word green (in several languages) as the next word, and away from flower words.
card.plain: It fires in plant descriptions just after the leaves are mentioned, when a color like green is likely to come next.
